mutationLog.title: Zero fills: TradingView 100% default margin
mutationLog.detail: First Alpha run returned 0 trades. Signals fired (46 OR breaks in recent bars), but 10+ MES contracts (~$350k notional) were refused at 100% margin on $50k. Set margin_long/short = 10%. Logic unchanged.

mutationLog.title: MES penalty: friction is ~15% of 1R
mutationLog.detail: Every agent scores PF 0.17-0.34 higher on MNQ than MES. Round-trip friction per contract: MES $2 fees + 2 ticks ($2.50) = $4.50 against 1R of about 1 ATR (~6 pts x $5 = $30), so ~15% of R. MNQ: $3 against ~$60, so ~5% of R. Alpha MES in-sample paid $7,028 in commission alone.

mutationLog.title: Stops too tight: 5m ATR includes overnight bars
mutationLog.detail: Alpha and Gamma average 5.7-6.5 bars (~30 min) per trade with win rates near 30-35%. ATR(14) on a 24h futures chart is depressed by quiet Globex bars, so a 1x ATR stop at 09:45 sits inside the opening noise.

mutationLog.title: Alpha eliminated in Gen 1 form (OOS touch 1 of 2)
mutationLog.detail: IS PF 0.71 (MES) / 1.05 (MNQ); OOS PF 0.78 / 0.96. Short side PF 0.62-0.98 everywhere. MES drawdown 56% at 1% risk.

mutationLog.title: Gamma over-trades the short side
mutationLog.detail: 268 shorts against 41 longs on MNQ. The short-only 'expansion without squeeze' trigger fires on most volatile bars. Longs (PF 1.26 on MNQ, 41 trades) are too few to judge.

mutationLog.title: Delta shorts fail in an up-trending sample
mutationLog.detail: Short PF 0.72 (MES) and 0.74 (MNQ) with 246-259 trades; longs 0.78 / 1.17. The 1h/15m bear regime flips too often in a market that rose ~30% over the IS window.

mutationLog.title: Beta is the strongest Gen 1 candidate
mutationLog.detail: MNQ IS PF 1.12, 721 trades, DD 14.2%, longs PF 1.18 over 511 trades. Its primary vehicle (SPX credit spreads) is untested; futures are only the fallback. The chop filter (ADX >= 20) contradicts a reversal thesis and is the first ablation.

mutationLog.title: Proposed: RTH-only ATR, stop floor 0.25 x daily ATR
mutationLog.detail: Compute ATR from RTH bars only and set stop = max(1.0 x ATR_RTH, 0.25 x dATR). Targets m002 and m003: fewer contracts per R, so less friction per R.
mutationLog.oosImpact: No OOS look (all cells failed IS). Win rate rose to 35-50% and hold time to 45-125 min; PF moved -0.04 to +0.16. Friction per R roughly halved, so friction is not what is killing these signals.

mutationLog.title: Proposed: drop the expansion-without-squeeze trigger
mutationLog.detail: Shorts need a real squeeze release, like longs. Asymmetry moves to exits only (2.5R target vs trailing).
mutationLog.oosImpact: No OOS look. Gamma shorts fell from 268 to 75 (MNQ) and 186 to 67 (MES); MNQ PF 1.02 to 1.18, MES PF 0.81 to 0.78. Trades fell below the 150 gate.

mutationLog.title: Proposed: chop-filter ablation for Beta
mutationLog.detail: Pre-registered ablation (spec section 2.1): run with ADX >= 20 off. Keep it off only if IS PF improves on both instruments.
mutationLog.oosImpact: No OOS look. MES: chop on 0.908 vs off 0.896, so the filter stays ON per the pre-registered rule. MNQ chop-on run missing (TradingView concurrency limit).

mutationLog.title: Proposed: shorts need 1h close below 1h EMA50
mutationLog.detail: A deeper bear-regime requirement for the short side only.
mutationLog.oosImpact: No OOS look. Delta short PF 0.78 (MES) and 0.76 (MNQ), unchanged from Gen 1. The short side has no edge in this sample.

mutationLog.title: Friction hypothesis refuted
mutationLog.detail: Gen 1 blamed MES friction (about 15% of R). m101 roughly halved friction per R, yet MES profit factors stayed at 0.78-0.91. The MNQ-over-MES gap persists, but the signals themselves show no edge on either instrument.

mutationLog.title: SPX credit floor rejects 34 of 35 Beta signals
mutationLog.detail: Measured net of $0.10 slippage, a 5-wide 0.10-0.15 delta spread lands just under 0.85 x |delta| x width, and wider wings fail by more because credit/width falls with width. Beta also produces only 35 SPX signals in 176 days (SPX has no overnight session, so there are no overnight levels to sweep).

mutationLog.title: SPX strike constraints leave Delta 1 trade from 157 signals
mutationLog.detail: Requiring the short strike beyond the pullback low, beyond the 1h EMA50 and at least 1.25x the remaining expected move away pushes it below 0.10 delta in 123 of 157 cases. The credit floor removes 33 more.

mutationLog.title: Gamma MNQ is the best cell so far, but the sample is thin
mutationLog.detail: PF 1.18, DD 5.3%, 110 trades. Longs PF 1.72 on 35 trades; shorts PF 0.96 on 75. The long result needs a null test before anyone trusts it: in a market that rose 40% over the window, random long entries also make money.

mutationLog.title: Proposed: one SPX relaxation (needs your approval)

mutationLog.oosImpact: Superseded by the Gen 3 pivot (m301): the directional SPX leg is dropped.

mutationLog.title: Proposed: retire Alpha
mutationLog.detail: Two generations, four cells, no in-sample PF above 1.05, one OOS look already spent (0.78 / 0.96). Further mutation would be curve-fitting.
mutationLog.oosImpact: Alpha retired at the Gen 3 pivot. Records kept.

mutationLog.title: Proposed: Delta as signal source only
mutationLog.detail: Delta's short side failed twice, so as a futures agent it can never pass the bidirectional gate. Keep its 1h/15m regime only as the bull-put filter for the SPX leg.
mutationLog.oosImpact: Superseded: all four agents retired at the pivot; direction is demoted to risk filters (H2).

mutationLog.title: Proposed: random-entry null test before any mutation
mutationLog.detail: Compare Gamma MNQ and Beta MNQ longs against random long entries at the same times of day, with the same exits. If they don't beat the null at p < 0.05, the long PF is just market drift.
mutationLog.oosImpact: Superseded: agents retired. The null-test discipline carries into H3 (random-direction null).

mutationLog.title: Pivot: from direction prediction to premium selling
mutationLog.detail: After 19 configurations with no directional edge, the four agents are retired. useChop = input.bool(true, "Chop filter: ADX<20 or range<0.35 dATR")
useDead = input.bool(true, "Midday dead zone 12:00-13:30 ET")

// ---------- time (America/New_York, bar OPEN time) ----------
tz = "America/New_York"
hhmm = hour(time, tz) * 100 + minute(time, tz)
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
rthStart = inRTH and not inRTH[1]

// ---------- session state, built in-script (no request.security on HTF) ----------
var float dH = na
var float dL = na
var float pdH = na
var float pdL = na
var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float orH = na
var float orL = na
var float onH = na
var float onL = na
var float sPV = 0.0
var float sV = 0.0
var float dATR = na
var float rthOpen = na
var int nL = 0
var int nS = 0
if hhmm == 1800
    onH := high
    onL := low
else if not inRTH and not na(onH)
    onH := math.max(onH, high)
    onL := math.min(onL, low)
if rthStart
    if not na(dH)
        tr = math.max(dH, nz(pdC, dH)) - math.min(dL, nz(pdC, dL))
        dATR := na(dATR) ? tr : (dATR * 13 + tr) / 14
        pdH := dH
        pdL := dL
        pdC := lastRthC
    dH := high
    dL := low
    orH := high
    orL := low
    sPV := 0.0
    sV := 0.0
    rthOpen := open
    nL := 0
    nS := 0
else if inRTH
    dH := math.max(dH, high)
    dL := math.min(dL, low)
    if hhmm < 945
        orH := math.max(orH, high)
        orL := math.min(orL, low)
if inRTH
    sPV += hlc3 * volume
    sV += volume
    lastRthC := close
vwap_ = sV > 0 ? sPV / sV : na
orReady = inRTH and hhmm >= 945

// ---------- shared indicators ----------
// m101 (Gen 2): ATR from RTH bars only + stop floor of 0.25 x daily ATR
atrStd = ta.atr(14)
trR = ta.tr(true)
var float atrR = na
if inRTH
    atrR := na(atrR) ? trR : (atrR * 13 + trR) / 14
atr = nz(atrR, atrStd)
stopFloor = nz(0.25 * dATR, 0.0)
[diP, diM, adx] = ta.dmi(14, 14)
rangeOk = hhmm < 1030 or na(dATR) ? true : (dH - dL) / dATR >= 0.35
chopOK = not useChop or (adx >= 20 and rangeOk)
deadZ = useDead and hhmm >= 1200 and hhmm < 1330

// ---------- event filter: FOMC decision days (TradingView economic calendar) ----------
var fomc = array.from(20220126, 20220316, 20220504, 20220615, 20220727, 20220921, 20221102, 20221214, 20230201, 20230322, 20230503, 20230614, 20230726, 20230920, 20231101, 20231213, 20240131, 20240320, 20240501, 20240612, 20240731, 20240918, 20241107, 20241218, 20250129, 20250319, 20250507, 20250618, 20250730, 20250917, 20251029, 20251210, 20260128, 20260318, 20260429, 20260617, 20260729, 20260916, 20261028, 20261209)
isFomc = array.includes(fomc, dInt)
fomcBlock = isFomc and hhmm >= 1355 and hhmm < 1430

// ---------- VIX (same timeframe, confirmed bars only) ----------
vixC = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
vixH = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, high, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
var float vixLast = na
var float vixPrev = na
if rthStart
    vixPrev := vixLast
if inRTH
    vixLast := vixC
vixUp = not na(vixPrev) and vixC > vixPrev

// ---------- sizing: fixed-fractional risk ----------
f_qty(float dist) =>
    float q = 0.0
    if dist > 0
        q := math.floor(strategy.equity * riskPct / 100.0 / (dist * syminfo.pointvalue))
    q

flat = strategy.position_size == 0
barsIn = strategy.position_size != 0 ? bar_index - strategy.opentrades.entry_bar_index(0) : 0
var float stopPx = na
var float tgtPx = na
var float rPts = na
var float entRef = na
var bool trailOn = false

// ================= AGENT ALPHA: Opening-range / VWAP / DMI momentum =================
ema9 = ta.ema(close, 9)
volSma = ta.sma(volume, 20)
var bool upUsed = false
var bool dnUsed = false
if rthStart
    upUsed := false
    dnUsed := false
upBreak = orReady and not upUsed and close > orH
dnBreak = orReady and not dnUsed and close < orL
if upBreak
    upUsed := true
if dnBreak
    dnUsed := true

winA = ((hhmm >= 945 and hhmm < 1200) or (hhmm >= 1330 and hhmm < 1500)) and not deadZ
canEnter = flat and winA and chopOK and not fomcBlock

longSig = canEnter and upBreak and close > vwap_ and adx >= 20 and diP > diM and volume > volSma and nL == 0
// Short is NOT a mirror: requires VIX up on the day, no volume requirement, fixed 2R target + time stop
shortSig = canEnter and dnBreak and close < vwap_ and adx >= 20 and diM > diP and vixUp and nS == 0

if longSig
    d = math.max(atr, stopFloor)
    q = f_qty(d)
    if q >= 1
        stopPx := close - d
        rPts := d
        entRef := close
        trailOn := false
        strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
        nL += 1
if shortSig
    d = math.max(atr, stopFloor)
    q = f_qty(d)
    if q >= 1
        stopPx := close + d
        tgtPx := close - 2.0 * d
        rPts := d
        entRef := close
        strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, qty=q)
        strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
        nS += 1

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "L", stop=stopPx)
    if high >= entRef + rPts
        trailOn := true
    if trailOn and close < ema9
        strategy.close("L", comment="trail EMA9")
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "S", stop=stopPx, limit=tgtPx)
    if barsIn >= 6 and close > entRef - 0.5 * rPts
        strategy.close("S", comment="time stop")

// ---------- end-of-day flatten ----------
if hhmm >= 1550 or not inRTH
    strategy.close_all(comment="EOD")

    lastPLvix := vixH[5]

    usePDH := false

    useORH := false
    useORL := false

sPDH = f_swUp(pdH, usePDH)

sORL = orReady and f_swDn(orL, useORL)

    useORH := useORH or sORH

bearDiv = not na(lastPH) and high > lastPH and rsi < lastPHrsi

knife = (not na(pdC) and not na(dATR) and rthOpen - pdC < -dATR) or close < vwap_ - 1.5 * atr
var bool pendBear = false
var bool pendBull = false

var float swLo = na
var float swMid = na
confBear = pendBear and close < swMid
confBull = pendBull and close > swMid

biasShort = h1E20 < h1E50 and h1C < h1E20 and h1C < h1E50 and bearCnt15 >= 2

f_ncdf(float x) =>
    float z = math.abs(x) / math.sqrt(2.0)
    float t = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.3275911 * z)
    float y = 1.0 - (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t * math.exp(-z * z)
    x >= 0 ? 0.5 * (1.0 + y) : 0.5 * (1.0 - y)
f_iv(float S, float K, float base, bool isPut) =>
    float m = isPut ? (S - K) / S * 100.0 : (K - S) / S * 100.0
    float mult = isPut ? 1.0 + putSkew * m : 1.0 - callSkew * m
    base * math.max(mult, 0.6)
f_bs(float S, float K, float T, float iv, bool isPut) =>
    float px = 0.0
    float dl = 0.0
    if T <= 0.0000001 or iv <= 0
        px := isPut ? math.max(K - S, 0) : math.max(S - K, 0)
        dl := isPut ? (S < K ? -1.0 : 0.0) : (S > K ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    else
        float sd = iv * math.sqrt(T)
        float d1 = (math.log(S / K) + 0.5 * iv * iv * T) / sd
        float d2 = d1 - sd
        if isPut
            px := K * f_ncdf(-d2) - S * f_ncdf(-d1)
            dl := f_ncdf(d1) - 1.0
        else
            px := S * f_ncdf(d1) - K * f_ncdf(d2)
            dl := f_ncdf(d1)
    [px, dl]
f_spread(float S, float Ks, float Kl, bool isPut, float T, float base) =>
    [ps, dlS] = f_bs(S, Ks, T, f_iv(S, Ks, base, isPut), isPut)
    [pk, dlL] = f_bs(S, Kl, T, f_iv(S, Kl, base, isPut), isPut)
    ps - pk
f_findShort(float S, float limitK, bool isPut, float T, float base, float dMax) =>
    float K0 = isPut ? math.floor(limitK / 5.0) * 5.0 : math.ceil(limitK / 5.0) * 5.0
    float found = na
    float fdl = na
    for i = 0 to 160
        float Ki = isPut ? K0 - 5.0 * i : K0 + 5.0 * i
        [p, dl] = f_bs(S, Ki, T, f_iv(S, Ki, base, isPut), isPut)
        if math.abs(dl) <= dMax
            found := Ki
            fdl := dl
            break
    [found, fdl]
f_intr(float S, float Ks, float Kl, bool isPut) =>
    isPut ? math.max(Ks - S, 0) - math.max(Kl - S, 0) : math.max(S - Ks, 0) - math.max(S - Kl, 0)

// ================= stats store: [period 0 = IS, 1 = OOS] x 27 fields =================

    else if hitB

    else if hhmm >= 1555

if exitNow
    float slipX = isSettle ? 0.0 : slipSpread
    float fees = 2.0 * pN * feeLeg + (isSettle ? 0.0 : 2.0 * pN * feeLeg)
    float pnl = (pC - exitV - slipX) * 100.0 * pN - fees
    f_add(pPer, 0, 1.0)
    f_add(pPer, 26, pnl)
    if pnl > 0
        f_add(pPer, 1, 1.0)
    f_add(pPer, pnl > 0 ? 2 : 3, math.abs(pnl))
    int sb = posPut ? 4 : 8
    f_add(pPer, sb, 1.0)
    if pnl > 0
        f_add(pPer, sb + 1, 1.0)
        f_add(pPer, sb + 2, pnl)
    else
        f_add(pPer, sb + 3, -pnl)
    f_add(pPer, 12, pnl)
    float eqN = f_g(pPer, 12)
    if eqN > f_g(pPer, 13)
        array.set(st, pPer * NF + 13, eqN)
    float ddN = (f_g(pPer, 13) - eqN) / f_g(pPer, 13) * 100.0
    if ddN > f_g(pPer, 14)
        array.set(st, pPer * NF + 14, ddN)
    f_add(pPer, 18, (time_close - pEntryT) / 60000.0)
    if reason > 0
        f_add(pPer, reason == 1 ? 23 : reason == 2 ? 24 : 25, 1.0)
    dayPnl += pnl
    inPos := false

bool win = agent == "Beta" ? (hhmm >= 1000 and hhmm < 1430 and not (hhmm >= 1200 and hhmm < 1330)) : (hhmm >= 1000 and hhmm < 1530 and not (hhmm >= 1200 and hhmm < 1330))
bool fomcNo = isFomc and hhmm >= 1300
bool goLong = agent == "Beta" ? confBull : dLong
bool goShort = agent == "Beta" ? confBear : dShort
if not inPos and not exitNow and inRTH and win and not fomcNo and not na(sig) and tmin > 10 and (goLong or goShort)
    bool isPut = goLong
    float limitK = na

        inval := isPut ? pbLow - 0.25 * atr : pbHigh + 0.25 * atr
    float dMax = isPut ? 0.15 : 0.20
    f_add(per, 19, 1.0)
    [Ks, dls] = f_findShort(close, limitK, isPut, Tyr, sig, dMax)
    bool pinBad = hhmm >= 1430 and not na(Ks) and math.abs(Ks - close) / close <= 0.005

    else

                float ml = (w - cr) * 100.0
                float nn = math.floor(eqP * 0.01 / ml)
                if not okF
                    floorFail := true
                else if nn < 1
                    budgetFail := true
                else
                    bestW := w
                    bestC := cr
                    bestN := nn

            f_add(per, floorFail ? 21 : 22, 1.0)
        else
            inPos := true
            posPut := isPut
            pKs := Ks
            pKl := isPut ? Ks - bestW : Ks + bestW

            pInv := inval

// 10:00 ET bar close, short strikes = first 5-pt strike with |delta| <= dMax on each side, fixed wings. Exit at 50% of
// credit (5m close value) or at the 15:30 close. No stop: max loss is defined by the wings.
// MODELED pricing: Black-Scholes, ATM IV = VIX1D x atmScale, linear put skew in moneyness (three values = three books).
// Skew calibrated 2026-11-20 from real SPXW 0DTE trades at 10:00 ET: put slope 0.10-0.31 per 1% OTM (regime-dependent), call side flat.
// Books 0-2: H1 (no filter). Books 3-5: H2 (skip if VIX > VIX3M, event day, or |open gap| > 1 daily ATR).
// In-sample only: nothing at or after oosStart is simulated, so the OOS window stays unseen.

skMid = input.float(0.20, "Put skew, mid book")
skHi = input.float(0.30, "Put skew, high book")

feeLeg = input.float(1.0, "Fee per contract per leg per side ($)")
wing = input.float(10, "Wing width (points)")
dMax = input.float(0.15, "Short strike max |delta|")
capital = input.float(100000, "Starting equity per book")
oosStart = timestamp("America/New_York", 2026, 8, 1, 0, 0)

tz = "America/New_York"

mi = minute(time, tz)
hhmm = hh * 100 + mi
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
rthStart = inRTH and (dInt != nz(dInt[1]) or not inRTH[1])
tmin = 960 - (hh * 60 + mi + 5)
Tyr = math.max(tmin, 0) / 390.0 / 252.0
inIS = time < oosStart

var float dH = na
var float dL = na
var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float dATR = na
var float rthOpen = na
if rthStart
    if not na(dH)
        tr = math.max(dH, nz(pdC, dH)) - math.min(dL, nz(pdC, dL))
        dATR := na(dATR) ? tr : (dATR * 13 + tr) / 14
        pdC := lastRthC
    dH := high
    dL := low
    rthOpen := open
else if inRTH

    dL := math.min(dL, low)

    lastRthC := close

vix1d = request.security("CBOE:VIX1D", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
vixC = request.security("CBOE:VIX", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
vix3m = request.security("CBOE:VIX3M", timeframe.period, close, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
sig = vix1d / 100.0 * atmScale

// FOMC + CPI + NFP + PCE release days (TradingView economic calendar)
var events = array.from(__EVENTS__)
isEvent = array.includes(events, dInt)
gapBig = not na(dATR) and not na(pdC) and math.abs(rthOpen - pdC) > dATR
termInv = not na(vix3m) and vixC > vix3m
skipFilt = isEvent or gapBig or termInv

f_ncdf(float x) =>
    float z = math.abs(x) / math.sqrt(2.0)
    float t = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.3275911 * z)
    float y = 1.0 - (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t * math.exp(-z * z)
    x >= 0 ? 0.5 * (1.0 + y) : 0.5 * (1.0 - y)
f_iv(float S, float K, float base, bool isPut, float ps) =>
    float m = isPut ? (S - K) / S * 100.0 : (K - S) / S * 100.0
    float mult = isPut ? 1.0 + ps * m : 1.0 - callSkew * m
    base * math.max(mult, 0.6)
f_bs(float S, float K, float T, float iv, bool isPut) =>
    float px = 0.0
    float dl = 0.0
    if T <= 0.0000001 or iv <= 0
        px := isPut ? math.max(K - S, 0) : math.max(S - K, 0)
        dl := isPut ? (S < K ? -1.0 : 0.0) : (S > K ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    else
        float sd = iv * math.sqrt(T)
        float d1 = (math.log(S / K) + 0.5 * iv * iv * T) / sd
        float d2 = d1 - sd
        if isPut
            px := K * f_ncdf(-d2) - S * f_ncdf(-d1)
            dl := f_ncdf(d1) - 1.0
        else
            px := S * f_ncdf(d1) - K * f_ncdf(d2)
            dl := f_ncdf(d1)
    [px, dl]
f_vert(float S, float Ks, float Kl, bool isPut, float T, float base, float ps) =>
    [a, da] = f_bs(S, Ks, T, f_iv(S, Ks, base, isPut, ps), isPut)
    [b, db] = f_bs(S, Kl, T, f_iv(S, Kl, base, isPut, ps), isPut)
    a - b
f_short(float S, bool isPut, float T, float base, float ps) =>
    float K0 = isPut ? math.floor(S / 5.0) * 5.0 : math.ceil(S / 5.0) * 5.0
    float found = na
    for i = 0 to 200
        float Ki = isPut ? K0 - 5.0 * i : K0 + 5.0 * i
        [p, dl] = f_bs(S, Ki, T, f_iv(S, Ki, base, isPut, ps), isPut)
        if math.abs(dl) <= dMax
            found := Ki
            break
    found
f_intr(float S, float kps, float kpl, float kcs, float kcl) =>
    math.max(kps - S, 0) - math.max(kpl - S, 0) + math.max(S - kcs, 0) - math.max(S - kcl, 0)

if barstate.isfirst

//@version=6
strategy("TQ H3 Intraday Momentum MNQ", overlay=true, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=false, initial_capital=100000, currency=currency.USD, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=1.0, slippage=1, pyramiding=0, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, margin_long=10, margin_short=10)
// Quant Tournament Gen 3 / H3 (pre-registered). Signal: sign of the first-half-hour return (prior RTH close -> 10:00 ET).
// Trade: enter in that direction at the 15:30 ET open, exit at the 16:00 ET open. No stop. 1x notional sizing.
// Null: a random-direction trade has mean 0, so t = mean(signed return - cost) / (sd / sqrt(n)).
// The in-script statistics are stamped into the comment of one marker trade opened after statsTime (it stays open,
// so it does not touch closed-trade performance).
costPts = input.float(1.5, "Round-trip cost per contract in index points ($2 fees + 2 ticks = $3 = 1.5 pts)")
statsTime = input.time(timestamp("America/New_York", 2025, 6, 27, 16, 30), "Stamp statistics after")

tz = "America/New_York"
hhmm = hour(time, tz) * 100 + minute(time, tz)
dInt = year(time, tz) * 10000 + month(time, tz) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, tz)
inRTH = hhmm >= 930 and hhmm < 1600
newDay = inRTH and (not inRTH[1] or dInt != nz(dInt[1]))

var float pdC = na
var float lastRthC = na
var float r1 = na
var float o1530 = na
if newDay
    pdC := lastRthC
    r1 := na
    o1530 := na
if inRTH
    lastRthC := close
if hhmm == 955 and not na(pdC)
    r1 := close / pdC - 1
if hhmm == 1530
    o1530 := open

qty = math.max(1, math.floor(strategy.equity / (close * syminfo.pointvalue)))
if hhmm == 1525 and not na(r1) and r1 != 0 and strategy.position_size == 0 and time < statsTime
    if r1 > 0
        strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, qty=qty)
    else
        strategy.entry("S", strategy.short, qty=qty)
if hhmm == 1555 and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="16:00 exit")

// ---------- statistics (per contract, index points) ----------
var float n = 0.0
var float sx = 0.0
var float sxx = 0.0
var float sy = 0.0
var float syy = 0.0
var float hits = 0.0
if hhmm == 1555 and not na(o1530) and not na(r1) and r1 != 0 and time < statsTime
    float rl = close - o1530
    float x = math.sign(r1) * rl - costPts
    float y = rl - costPts
    n += 1
    sx += x
    sxx += x * x
    sy += y
    syy += y * y
    hits += math.sign(r1) * rl > 0 ? 1 : 0

var bool stamped = false
if not stamped and time >= statsTime and n > 2
    stamped := true
    float mx = sx / n
    float sdx = math.sqrt(math.max(sxx / n - mx * mx, 0) * n / (n - 1))
    float tx = sdx > 0 ? mx / (sdx / math.sqrt(n)) : na
    float my = sy / n
    float sdy = math.sqrt(math.max(syy / n - my * my, 0) * n / (n - 1))
    float ty = sdy > 0 ? my / (sdy / math.sqrt(n)) : na
    string txt = "STATS n=" + str.tostring(n, "#") + " mean_pts=" + str.tostring(mx, "#.###") + " sd=" + str.tostring(sdx, "#.##") + " t=" + str.tostring(tx, "#.##") + " hit=" + str.tostring(hits / n, "#.###") + " | always-long mean_pts=" + str.tostring(my, "#.###") + " t=" + str.tostring(ty, "#.##")
    strategy.entry("STATS", strategy.long, qty=1, comment=txt)
